findings.title: Generic Error thrown instead of TRPCError
findings.body: A plain `Error` is thrown when the credential is missing or not owned by the user, so tRPC maps it to INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR (500) rather than NOT_FOUND or FORBIDDEN. This also pollutes error monitoring. Throw `TRPCError` with the appropriate code.

findings.title: Cache deletion does not refresh the connected calendars query
findings.body: The deleteCache mutation's onSuccess only shows a toast and calls the optional `onSuccess` prop. It never invalidates `viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars`. The cache status entry therefore keeps showing the old `cacheUpdatedAt` and the 'Delete cached data' option stays visible, even though the cache is gone. The disconnect mutation does invalidate; this one should too.

findings.title: Pointless updateMany with empty data
findings.body: `updateManyByCredentialId(credentialId, {})` relies on Prisma `@updatedAt` behaviour for an empty update. Prisma may skip the write or touch every SelectedCalendar row for the credential, and each cache refresh issues this extra DB write. The UI uses CalendarCache.updatedAt rather than SelectedCalendar.updatedAt, so the extra write has no consumer.

findings.title: macOS-only sed -i syntax and unrelated script
findings.body: `sed -i ''` works only on BSD/macOS sed. On GNU/Linux it treats '' as the script and fails. The script is also unrelated to this feature, and it uses a relative `../.env` path that depends on the working directory.

findings.title: Hardcoded en-US date locale
findings.body: The timestamp is formatted with a hardcoded "en-US" locale instead of the user's locale, so non-English users see US-formatted dates.
